arc.want: sell the ferry and leave the island
arc.need: accept that she belongs to the island
be seen as more than a buyer

scenes.goal: close the last crossing of the season and lock the ticket office
scenes.conflict: Ines refuses to hand over the old ledger and the tide is turning
scenes.outcome: Mara leaves with the ledger but owes Ines a promise

change.from: ferry is a chore to be sold
change.to: ferry holds a promise she did not choose

scenes.goal: get a fair price from the first buyer
scenes.conflict: Joss offers half the value and hints he knows about the debt
scenes.outcome: Mara refuses, and Joss gives her until the next full moon

change.to: sale has a deadline and a threat

scenes.goal: find proof of the debt Joss mentioned
scenes.conflict: the ledger pages for that year have been torn out
scenes.outcome: she finds one surviving page and it names a third owner

scenes.goal: ask Ines who the third owner is
scenes.conflict: Ines lies, and Mara catches the lie
scenes.outcome: Mara commits to keeping the ferry running until she learns the truth

scenes.conflict: an engine fault and a storm front
scenes.outcome: she brings the ferry in by hand and the island notices

scenes.goal: trace the third owner through the harbour records
scenes.conflict: Joss has bought the records office the week before
scenes.outcome: she learns the third owner is her late father

scenes.goal: make Mara sign before the full moon
scenes.conflict: his own backers press him and Mara will not answer the phone
scenes.outcome: he decides to cut the ferry's fuel supply

scenes.goal: buy fuel from the mainland depot
scenes.conflict: the depot has been told not to sell to her
scenes.outcome: the ferry is stranded and the last crossing is cancelled

scenes.conflict: pride, and the fear that they will want her to leave
scenes.outcome: the islanders bring fuel by hand, one can at a time

scenes.goal: cross before the full moon tide to reach the lighthouse records
scenes.conflict: Joss blocks the channel with his own boat
scenes.outcome: she opens the lighthouse with the key and finds the deed

scenes.goal: keep Joss from taking the deed
scenes.outcome: she lets him read it and he sees his own family named in it

scenes.conflict: the offer to leave arrives on the same morning
scenes.outcome: she tears up the offer and takes the first crossing
